title: Requirements-to-CAD Generation Engine — Overview and definition
t: Requirements-to-CAD Generation Engine — Overview and definition
description: Drafts parametric CAD concepts directly from requirement text.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Drafts parametric CAD concepts directly from requirement text. A requirements-to-CAD engine parses requirement statements, extracts parameters and constraints, and generates parametric CAD candidates with a feature tree. Real implementations combine NLP extractors with CAD APIs (FreeCAD, Onshape) and generative design backends. Every generated feature links back to the requirement that demanded it.
capabilities: Requirement parsing into parameters and constraints
Variant generation across the parameter space

title: Requirements-to-CAD Generation Engine — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Drafts parametric CAD concepts directly from requirement text.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Requirements-to-CAD Generation Engine, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Requirement parsing into parameters and constraints). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Requirement parsing into parameters and constraints and Parametric feature-tree generation. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (AI-generated design constraint validator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
